verdict.rationale: Mobile on-call apps are a fair axis for an incident and on-call product, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a mobile app or acknowledging, escalating, or resolving from a phone. Slack/Teams incident declaration and web-based escalation configuration are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, a full mobile app lets me acknowledge, escalate, and resolve from my phone at 3am
